news.title: Meta FAIR Releases e-means: An Algorithm Beating k-means in 10x Fewer Epochs
news.dek:
Meta FAIR’s e-means is a mini-batch k-means replacement shipped in FAISS 1.16.0. It reaches Lloyd’s 25-epoch loss in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, with 10-45x GPU speedups and no extra hyperparameters. 
 The post  Meta FAIR Releases e-means: An Algorithm Beating k-means in 10x Fewer Epochs
news.aiSummary: Meta FAIR has introduced e-means, a new mini-batch k-means replacement, which is now available in FAISS 1.16.0. This algorithm achieves the same loss as Lloyd's k-means in significantly fewer epochs, specifically 1.4 to 2.6 epochs compared to 25. It also offers substantial GPU speedups of 10-45x without requiring additional hyperparameters.
